review:
A fantasy battle on Megaways reels, where crown wilds carry a 2x multiplier.

The bonus opens with a Wheel of Fortune that sets two things: how many free spins you get (5 to 15) and one multiplier, from 2x to 25x, that applies to every win in the round. That first spin of the wheel decides a lot. Very high volatility, 6,000x max and 96.75% RTP. Free spins about once every 136 spins. Same engine as Lady Wolf Moon Megaways.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 136 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
